items.title: Google Deepmind's Project Genie update brings Genie 4, chainable worlds, and a community gallery for remixing
items.summary: With Genie 4, Google DeepMind is launching its most realistic world model to date for Google AI Ultra subscribers. It generates interactive 3D worlds that can be modified in real time via text input and, for the first time, includes native sound. A community gallery allows users to share and remix the worlds they've created....

items.title: Microsoft is replacing outside AI models in its own products with cheaper in-house alternatives
items.summary: Microsoft's AI division MAI unveiled seven new models for code, security, images, language, and routing at Ignite. MAI Code 2 reaches 98 percent of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at 40 percent of the cost, according to Microsoft. The models are built for running AI agents around the clock in enterprises....

items.title: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
items.summary: OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI can redact or delay reports, so how independent this oversight actually turns out to be remains an open question....

items.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
items.summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier model built for software development, knowledge work, and science. It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a context window of one million tokens. At $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, Neon is priced above previous Gemini 4 models....
